parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: The wheel is a small metallic part located at the top of the lighter, typically made of steel.
parts.Functional_description: It generates sparks when rotated against the flint, igniting the fuel vapor to produce a flame.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis when the user rolls it with their thumb to create friction and spark.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: The button is a small plastic lever located near the top of the lighter.
parts.Functional_description: It releases the butane gas when pressed, allowing ignition when combined with the spark from the wheel.
parts.Movement_description: It moves downward when pressed and returns to its original position when released.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main housing of the lighter, typically made of durable polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the fuel reservoir and supports the ignition components, providing structure and grip.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the main structural component of the lighter.
